title: 卡莎·紫光小灯
description: 深紫发卡莎保留双肩甲壳，穿完整不透的生体衣，坐在台阶上观察小灯笼。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Kai'Sa is an adult woman with long dark violet hair, violet cheek markings, alert purple eyes, and two distinctive curved living shoulder pods. Preserve the organic purple carapace silhouette, but make her outfit a fully opaque high-neck long-sleeved bodysuit with covered legs and boots, no exposed cleavage or midriff. The shoulder pods are folded and inactive, without projectiles or threatening effects.
art_direction.scene: She sits on a broad low step and cups a small ordinary lantern between her hands, watching its soft glow with a relieved gentle smile. A few smooth violet stones and one tiny pale flower suggest a fantastical refuge. Keep the shoulder pods tucked back, the face unobstructed, and the simple scene warm rather than ominous.
art_direction.palette: deep violet, lavender, amber lantern, warm cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
